body:
Source: release review of v1.11.1..main. Re-verified @ e4b58abe:
- scripts/test/prompt-fencing.test.mjs derives its completeness candidates with a regex that only matches a static `import { ... } from '@adlc/core'`, and only lists the top level of packages/*/{lib,bin}. packages/gate-fuzzing/lib/fan.mjs sends every adversary prompt through `import('@adlc/core').then(({ complete }) => complete(call))` (its production path; bin/gate-fuzzing.mjs passes completeFn: null), so it is in neither GUARDED nor UNGUARDED_REVIEWED and the sweep stays green. Nested modules (packages/fleet/lib/adapters/*) and host-plugin senders (plugins/adlc-pi/lib/prosecutor.mjs, plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/prosecute-runner.mjs) are never candidates either.
- fan.mjs splices gate.docs, the baseline manifest and prior-defeat `rationale` (the adversary model's own earlier output) into the prompt without fence().
- plugins/adlc-pi/lib/prosecutor.mjs (buildLensPrompt/buildVerifierPrompt) and plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/prosecute-runner.mjs splice the diff under prosecution, the finding under verification and (pi) the ticket title raw into child prompts.
- packages/lesson-foundry/lib/emit.mjs buildCheckScript writes `// Grep gate: ${desc}` where desc is the first finding's description with only backticks replaced. A newline in desc ends the comment: buildCheckScript('demo', [{ desc: "x\nprocess.stdout.write('INJECTED'); process.exit(42);\n//" }]) produces a script that prints INJECTED and exits 42 when run. buildSkillStub writes the same text into SKILL.md frontmatter, where a newline adds keys.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Detector: new module scripts/prompt-senders.mjs (sendsPrompts(src), promptSendingModules(root)) consumed by scripts/test/prompt-fencing.test.mjs. fence(label, content, maxChars, { bias }) lives in packages/core/lib/text.mjs and emits <<UNTRUSTED:label:uuid>> ... <<END:label:uuid>>. Tests: `node --test scripts/test/prompt-senders.test.mjs scripts/test/prompt-fencing.test.mjs`, `npm test -w packages/gate-fuzzing`, `npm test -w packages/lesson-foundry`, `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/*.test.mjs`, `node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/*.test.mjs`. The detector's tests read real repo files, no temp dirs.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. A module counts as a prompt sender when it (a) statically imports complete, fan or fanProviders from core, (b) dynamically imports core and destructures one of those names via `const { ... } = await import(...)` or `.then(({ ... }) => ...)`, (c) dynamically imports core with bindings the detector cannot read (fail closed: counts as a sender), or (d) calls `session.prompt(` or builds a `['-p', prompt` / `['--print', prompt` argv. Candidates: every .mjs under packages/<pkg>/{lib,bin} and plugins/<plugin>, at any depth, skipping node_modules, test, cli-test, adapter-test and fixtures directories.
2. Every candidate appears in GUARDED or in UNGUARDED_REVIEWED with a reason; fan.mjs, the pi prosecutor and the opencode prosecute-runner are GUARDED; the fleet adapters and the opencode keyless-bridge are recorded as send-only.
3. gate-fuzzing fences GATE_DOCS, BASELINE_MANIFEST and PRIOR_DEFEATS; pi fences DIFF, FINDING and TICKET_TITLE; opencode fences DIFF and FINDING. A forged closing marker inside the content cannot end the fence.
4. lesson-foundry collapses line terminators (including U+2028/U+2029) and control characters in finding text to a space before writing it into the generated check script comment or SKILL.md frontmatter (description and name); backticks are still replaced.
5. Documentation: docs/lifecycle-threat-model.md describes the sweep and its detector.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 The detector counts static, dynamic, unreadable-dynamic and host-session sends, walks nested dirs and plugins, and finds gate-fuzzing/lib/fan.mjs. verify: `node --test scripts/test/prompt-senders.test.mjs`
- AC2 The sweep classifies every detected sender. verify: `node --test scripts/test/prompt-fencing.test.mjs`
- AC3 gate-fuzzing prompt content is fenced. verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/prompt-fencing.test.mjs`
- AC4 pi and opencode prosecution prompts fence the diff and finding. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/prompt-fencing.test.mjs plugins/adlc-opencode/test/prompt-fencing.test.mjs`
- AC5 A multi-line finding description cannot add executable lines to the generated check script or keys to SKILL.md frontmatter. verify: `node --test packages/lesson-foundry/test/emit-desc-injection.test.mjs`
- AC6 Existing suites green. verify: `npm test -w packages/gate-fuzzing && npm test -w packages/lesson-foundry && node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/*.test.mjs plugins/adlc-opencode/test/*.test.mjs scripts/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC7 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0

OUT OF SCOPE: prosecutor charter hardening in the codex, antigravity and claude-code harnesses; autopilot's claude -p shaping send (prompt piped on stdin, already fenced); spec-gap markdown lines in lesson-foundry; changes to fence() itself.
title: prompt-fencing: fence every prompt sender the completeness sweep misses and keep finding text out of generated code
